title: Settlement Guideline: Guest Payments and Deductible on HostCover Pet-Damage Claims by Level
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) pet-damage claims.** The pet recovery-sharing method follows the plan level and decides how the guest payments recorded on the claim, net of reversals, are shared between Roamhaven and the host. The adjusted pet-damage loss is the pet-damage loss being settled, before guest payments and the deductible come off it; the deductible is the one the pet-damage claim bears.

**HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite, HostCover Estate.** The guest payments first restore the deductible the pet-damage claim bears, so only the larger of those payments and that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted pet-damage loss.

> Hypothetical: adjusted loss 1500.00, guest payments 120.00, deductible 100.00. The larger, 120.00, is subtracted: 1380.00 left.

**HostCover Standard, HostCover Plus.** The guest payments are shared in proportion to the parts of the loss each side bears, so that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted pet-damage loss together with the guest payments multiplied by the adjusted pet-damage loss less that deductible (never below 0.00) and divided by the adjusted pet-damage loss.

> Hypothetical: adjusted loss 1500.00, guest payments 120.00, deductible 300.00. Subtracted: 300.00 plus 120.00 multiplied by 1200.00 and divided by 1500.00 (96.00), that is 396.00: 1104.00 left.

**Any other level (HostCover Essential).** The guest payments and that deductible are both subtracted from the adjusted pet-damage loss.

> Hypothetical: adjusted loss 1500.00, guest payments 120.00, deductible 300.00. Subtracted: 420.00; 1080.00 left.

Guest payments are those recorded on the pet-damage claim, less any reversed by the guest's card issuer.
